channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Indian Airlines Resume 58 Flights, Evacuate Thousands Stranded in West Asia Amid Ongoing Conflict Crisis
item.description: Indian carriers run special and limited scheduled flights to bring home thousands of stranded passengers safely.

item.title: Brent Crude Hits $83 as Middle East Conflict Disrupts Shipping, Sparks Diesel, Gasoline Market Surge Globally
item.description: Oil prices climb sharply as U.S.–Israel attacks on Iran disrupt Gulf shipping and global energy supplies.

item.title: One Layoff Destroys Eight Years of Work: Bengaluru Man Loses ₹1.2 Crore Home After 3 Missed EMIs
item.description: Bengaluru man loses ₹1.2 crore flat after missing three EMIs post-job layoff, raising financial preparedness debate.

item.title: Tamil Nadu: Late-Night Gang Assault in Tirunelveli Leaves 2 Dead, 5 Injured, Sparks Village Protests
item.description: A sudden sickle attack outside a Perumpathu tea shop kills two and injures five, triggering protests and police investigation.

item.title: Nagpur Horror: Holi Turns Tragic as Grandmother Allegedly Scalds Grandson With Boiling Water for Spraying Colours on Her
item.description: Nagpur Holi turns tragic as grandmother scalds grandson; UP clashes leave 11 injured.

item.title: Crude Climbs Toward $80 Amid Middle East Tensions: Are Fuel Prices in India Set to Rise?
item.description: As global oil prices spike nearly 10% over Middle East tensions, India relies on reserves and pricing buffers to avoid immediate petrol and diesel hikes.

item.title: 20-Year-Old Killed, Passenger Alleges Assault: 2 BMTC Incidents Raise Serious Safety Concerns in Bengaluru
item.description: Two BMTC incidents assault allegation and fatal crash raise commuter safety concerns in Bengaluru.

item.title: Gas Crisis Hits Gujarat’s Morbi Ceramic Hub as Iran War Widens, Putting 4 Lakh Jobs at Risk
item.description: Global energy disruptions from the West Asia conflict threaten production and livelihoods in Gujarat’s ceramic manufacturing hub, Morbi.

item.title: US Submarine Sinks Iranian Warship Near Sri Lanka, 87 Dead in Major Escalation
item.description: A US submarine torpedoed Iran’s IRIS Dena near Sri Lanka, killing 87, escalating wider tensions.

item.title: Rockets, Missiles and Drones Fly Across Iran and Israel as Middle East Conflict Widens
item.description: Coordinated airstrikes by the United States and Israel targeted key military and strategic sites in Iran, causing major explosions and damage.
